summary: Jaguar Health, Inc. filed a prospectus supplement (No. 7) under Rule 424(b)(5) amending its existing at-the-market (ATM) offering program. The filing reduces the aggregate offering price of common stock available for sale to approximately $4.78 million due to Form S-3 General Instruction I.B.6 limitations. The company became subject to these limits on March 31, 2025. As of the filing date, approximately $214,660 worth of shares had been sold under this instruction during the prior 12-month period. The ATM program, originally established December 10, 2021, currently has Ladenburg Thalmann as sole sales agent. This is a routine shelf takedown and not a special situation.
